_comment: STRICT-configuration campaign case inventory (predictor phase B). All namelists read read-only on 2026-09-14; values transcribed from the actual namelist.input in each prep_dir, not from the task's summary table. radt is minutes (WRF convention) except physics_suite cases where radt is a literal namelist value under a suite default. history_key names the &time_control key that actually carries the history-write interval in this namelist (history_interval vs history_interval_m) so the namelist editor sets the right one. 2026-09-14 all-ADIOS2 switch: added bp_dir (where the runner symlinks wrfinput_d0N.bp/wrfbdy_d01.bp from); input_files now holds only non-netCDF auxiliary files (Thompson tables, fields_d0N.txt, etc.) since wrfinput/wrfbdy are always BP now, never listed there.

conus25.notes: physics_suite='conus'; per-scheme physics_* values are the literal -1 (suite default) namelist values, not the schemes actually selected by the suite at runtime

conus12.notes: physics_suite='conus'; per-scheme physics_* values are the literal -1 (suite default) namelist values, not the schemes actually selected by the suite at runtime

isc21.notes: CP-1 ISC21 3-domain (the ISC2021 Student Cluster Competition WRF benchmark). Verified 2026-09-14: max_dom/e_we/e_sn/e_vert/dx/parent_grid_ratio/parent_time_step_ratio/time_step/radt/mp/bl_pbl/sf_sfclay/cu/run_minutes/interval_seconds/feedback all match the task spec against the real namelist.input. Native io_form_history=0 (primary wrfout stream OFF; the benchmark instead writes to auxhist24) -- edit_namelist's unconditional io_form_history=2 turns the primary stream back on so diffwrf has wrfout_d01_* frames, per task instruction. Native history-interval key is history_interval_s (SECONDS, per-domain list of 3, all 00) -- NOT history_interval or history_interval_m; configs.py's namelist editor was extended to recognize this third variant and write minutes*60. mp_physics=8 (Thompson, non-hail-aware) opens 'qr_acr_qg_V4.dat' and 'qr_acr_qsV2.dat' at init (module_mp_thompson.F:4124,4339) plus 'freezeH2O.dat'; this prep_dir has qr_acr_qgV2.dat (wrong name for mp=8, harmless -- WRF silently computes qr_acr_qg_V4 itself since force_read_thompson defaults to .false. and is not set here, RISK: adds uncosted init time, not fatal) and the exact-match qr_acr_qsV2.dat + freezeH2O.dat. iofields_filename references fields_d01/02/03.txt, all present in prep_dir and symlinked. cu_physics is 1,0,0 (non-uniform: KF on d01 only) -- cases.json's scalar physics.cu_physics records d01's value (1) per the d01-scalar-for-ledger convention; ra_lw/sw/mp/sf_sfclay/sf_surface/bl_pbl are uniform across domains. CEN_LAT=30.57 CEN_LON=119.36 (ncdump wrfinput_d01) -- East China coast, mid-latitude synoptic-scale nest, not a TC-tracking domain like karina/maria1km -> case_family=continental_benchmark. 2026-09-14 STRICT-campaign edits: steps raised from the generic 32 to 25 (step 1 + 24 = 6 whole radiation cycles of 4, radt=3 -> a radiation step every 4 d01 steps per smoke job 1074515) so the per-config sample covers whole cycles cheaply; namelist_overrides gained io_form_auxhist24=0 to disable the ISC2021 validation aux stream for the STRICT compute campaign -- diffwrf only ever compares wrfout_d01_* frames, the aux stream is identical across every config regardless of decomposition/tiling, and it cost ~15.8 s per frame every model minute in the smoke job, i.e. config-independent, non-informative wall time. Nested-domain (d02/d03) history is now off by default (configs.py nest_history_on default False) for the same diffwrf-only-checks-d01 reason plus the nested wrfout I/O cost measured in the same smoke job (d02 38.2+53.7 s, d03 60.1+82.6 s for just 2 frames).

lafe.notes: 2026-09-14 USER DECISION: d01 ONLY, physics unchanged (STRICT). This WRF build aborts the template's d01 MYNN (bl_pbl_physics=5) + d02 LES (bl_pbl_physics=0) nest at startup with 'LES PBL on fine grid does not work with CG PBL option 5' (smoke job 1074659); running d02 would require changing the physics. The d01+d02 text below is historical. DOI-4 LAFE 2017 (DOE ARM Land-Atmosphere Feedback Experiment field campaign), originally run as d01+d02 only --wrfinput_d03 exists in prep_dir but is deliberately excluded from input_files. Template is namelist.input.LAFE_2500_500_100_MYNN (prep_dir itself, WRFINPUT_BDY/, has no namelist.input), confirmed max_dom=3/e_we/e_sn/e_vert/dx/ratio/time_step/radt/mp/bl_pbl/sf_sfclay/sf_surface(Noah-MP)/io_form_* all match the task spec. namelist_overrides trims to max_dom=2 (extra per-domain list entries for d03 are left in the file untouched by _set_scalar/_delete_key_lines/edit_namelist -- WRF only reads the first max_dom entries of a max_domains-dim namelist var, so this is harmless, not deleted, per the task's 'harmless, trim if simple' allowance). 2026-09-14 all-ADIOS2 switch: dropped the io_form_input/io_form_boundary=2 (pnetcdf->plain netCDF) override entirely -- edit_namelist now forces io_form_input/boundary/history/restart=14 (ADIOS2) unconditionally AFTER overrides are applied, so a stale io_form override can never revert it; the template's native io_form_input/boundary=11 (pnetcdf) is overwritten the same way. RISK verified 2026-09-14: mp_physics=28 (Thompson aerosol-aware) opens qr_acr_qg_V4.dat, qr_acr_qsV2.dat and freezeH2O.dat at init (same module_mp_thompson.F code path as isc21) but NONE of the three exist anywhere under /home/u5727520/wrf-bench/atlas/lafe2017/ (checked WRFINPUT_BDY.tar.gz listing and extract/ tree) -- WRF will compute all Thompson lookup tables from scratch on rank 0 at startup (force_read_thompson defaults .false., not fatal, but can add real minutes to init time beyond the 150s GUESS). aer_opt=3 with use_aero_icbc=.true. reads aerosol fields baked into wrfinput itself, no extra file. sf_surface_physics=4 (Noah-MP) needs NoahmpTable.TBL/SOILPARM.TBL/GENPARM.TBL/VEGPARM.TBL, all present in WRF run/ and auto-symlinked by the sbatch script's generic run/-file loop (not in input_files, no case-specific action needed). iofields_filename references 'no_output.txt' (does not exist anywhere) but ignore_iofields_warning=.true. is already set in the template, so module_domain.F:1184-1198 downgrades the missing-file condition to a non-fatal warning -- verified against WRF source, not a real risk. bl_pbl_physics is 5,0 for d01,d02 (non-uniform: MYNN off on the LES-scale d02) -- scalar physics.bl_pbl_physics records d01 (5). CEN_LAT=36.21 CEN_LON=-97.48 (ncdump wrfinput_d01) -- DOE ARM Southern Great Plains site, Oklahoma: a fine-resolution (2500m/500m) nested land-atmosphere/boundary-layer study domain, not a continental synoptic-scale benchmark or a TC domain -> case_family=boundary_layer_fine_scale (new family, not reused from karina/conus/maria1km). 2026-09-14 STRICT-campaign edits: the template namelist.input.LAFE_2500_500_100_MYNN fails in this build with 'ERROR while reading namelist physics' / 'ERROR while reading namelist noah_mp' -- Registry.EM_COMMON check (2026-09-14) found bl_mynn_tkebudget is NOT in this build (successor: tke_budget, physics, max_domains, default 0; the template's bl_mynn_tkebudget=0,0,0 already equals that default, so deleting the key changes nothing else) and opt_run is NOT in this build either (split into opt_runsrf/opt_runsub, noah_mp, default 3 each; the template's opt_run=3 equals both defaults). namelist_delete_keys strips both lines before edit_namelist's other edits run. steps raised from the generic 32 to 25 (step 1 + 24 = 4 whole radiation cycles of 6, radt=1 min at dt=10s -> a radiation step every 6 d01 steps) so the sample covers whole cycles cheaply. Nested-domain (d02) history is now off by default (configs.py nest_history_on default False) since diffwrf only ever compares wrfout_d01_* frames and nested wrfout I/O dominated per-run wall time in the maria1km/isc21 smoke jobs (same mechanism, not separately smoke-tested for lafe yet).

maria1km.notes: OB-3 Maria 1 km (finest active nest d02: dx=5000/parent_grid_ratio=5=1000 m => the '1km' in the case name is d02's resolution, d01 stays 5 km). Extracted by job 1074480 (COMPLETED 00:01:21) into prep_dir 2026-09-14; namelist.input there already has restart=.false., io_form_history/input/boundary=2 natively (a separate namelist.input.restart sibling file carries restart=.true. and is NOT used) -- namelist_overrides.restart=.false. is included defensively/for documentation even though it is already the template's native value, per the task's cold-start requirement. wrfinput_d01/d02 Times (strings) read as 2017-09-20_09:00:00, matching namelist start_year/month/day/hour=2017,09,20,09 exactly -- confirmed consistent. Grid: d01 900x900x50 dx=5000m dt=25s; d02 1661x1591x50, parent_grid_ratio=5, parent_time_step_ratio=5 (d03's 94x91@ratio3 exists in the file but is inactive under max_dom=2 and not touched). physics_suite='tropical' with all physics_* = -1 (suite default, actual scheme resolved at runtime, same caveat as conus25/conus12); radt=12,12 (d01,d02, uniform); cudt=0,0. Both qr_acr_qg.dat (exact match for mp=8/28's qr_acr_qg_V4.dat filename? NO -- checked module_mp_thompson.F:4120-4124, the exact-match filename is always 'qr_acr_qg_V4.dat', so this prep_dir's 'qr_acr_qg.dat' and 'qr_acr_qgV2.dat' are BOTH non-matching names too; only 'qr_acr_qsV2.dat' and 'freezeH2O.dat' are exact matches) and freezeH2O.dat symlinked regardless since they're cheap and harmless if unused by whatever scheme the 'tropical' suite actually resolves to. COST_GUESS raised from the task's 2.0 s/step starting point to 4.0 s/step (GUESS): d02's grid (1661x1591) is ~3.25x karina's entire single-domain workload (901x901) and is sub-stepped 5x per d01 step (parent_time_step_ratio=5), so per-d01-step cost should exceed karina's 0.30 s/step by well over an order of magnitude on total workload grounds; 4.0 s/step is a conservative middle estimate, not a measurement. 2026-09-14 STRICT-campaign edits: steps raised from the generic 32 to 30 to include one radiation step at ~step 29 (radt=12 min at dt=25s -> a radiation step every ~29 steps), giving the sample a radiation-cycle boundary instead of stopping just short of it. COST_GUESS updated from the 4.0 s/step GUESS above to a measured ~5.8 s/step (smoke jobs 1074515-1074517, nest history still ON in that smoke run; lead will re-measure with nest IO off). Nested-domain (d02) history is now off by default (configs.py nest_history_on default False) since diffwrf only ever compares wrfout_d01_* frames and d02's wrfout frames cost 105.1 s + 114.9 s in the smoke job (564 s total wall).
